# Small Sprint 1 architecture alignment patch — OWNER AUTHORIZED (2026-11-09)

**Parent programme:** [#92 — five-project architecture references](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/issues/92). This is a **bounded Sprint 1 integration patch** to preserve and clarify current OpsControl architecture while establishing evidence-based development-phase end-to-end workflow certification. It is **not** permission to build or copy five entire products, add Grafana as a dependency, or begin Sprint 2.

**Execution sequencing:** Codex is already working on **OC-S1-CI-004** in draft [PR #89](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/pull/89). Run this patch **after** the current Codex change is pushed and verified to avoid simultaneous writes to the same PR branch. Refresh the exact head and check conflict risk before editing. Preserve PR #89 as DRAFT and all 13 active required contexts.

## Small patch — required deliverables

1. **Add `docs/architecture/SPRINT1_E2E_ALIGNMENT.md`** (or equivalent established architecture documentation path): map current **Organization → Data Source → pinned typed template/collector → ingestion/OTel-compatible transport → persisted PostgreSQL evidence/current metric → alert/rule/outbox → authorized operator UI**. Identify which parts actually exist vs proposed, the authoritative data source, collector freshness, tenant/RBAC boundary, source generation/revisions, idempotency, no credentials/checkpoints in audit history, and durable queue/replay limitations. Explicitly distinguish native ETL **execution/attempt/evidence** from metric time series and monitoring health. Confirm Kubernetes/EKS/AKS/GKE/OpenShift remain excluded; background incident functionality and excluded Incidents UI retain existing approved behavior. Do not reproduce stale statements implying live certification.
2. **Add `docs/verification/sprint1-integration/E2E_WORKFLOW_MATRIX.md`** with one row per bounded workflow and columns `workflow_id, source-to-UI journey, owner, environment, source SHA, exact test command/job, actual evidence path, last result, status classification, certification authority, blockers`. Include at minimum: (a) resource/template configuration and CAS/rollback, (b) Windows/Linux host/process/metric sampling and freshness, (c) HTTPS API health and negative TLS/egress, (d) read-only ETL identity/start/attempt/completion and schedule/NO_RUN, (e) metric→rule/alert→outbox/notification, (f) multi-tenant RBAC/user/revocation and customer switching, and (g) browser historical time range/frequency/aggregation. If a whole path is not integrated yet, mark **PARTIAL/NOT_IMPLEMENTED/BLOCKED** without inventing tests, certification, owners or data.
3. **Evidence levels:** distinguish `DESIGNED`, `IMPLEMENTED`, `CONTROLLED_E2E_VERIFIED`, `GENUINE_PROVIDER_VERIFIED`, `INDEPENDENTLY_ACCEPTED`, and `RELEASE_ELIGIBLE`. The controlled stage must prove authenticated UI + actual API + migrated PostgreSQL + real relevant collector/worker integration (where part of the contract), negative tenant/cross-session/egress and failure/restart. Fixture-only evidence does **not** certify real Windows/Linux native providers, Pentaho builds, external APIs, cloud targets, or collector durability. Mark no blanket `CERTIFIED` without explicit bounded environment and evidence.
4. **Add a small verification guard** (unit/checklist/static test consistent with repository CI conventions) checking all required workflows have explicit statuses and nonempty exact evidence references **when marked verified**; refuse contradictory unknown statuses, invented provider certification, or links to nonexistent evidence. For pending/blocked workflows, allow explicit missing evidence and record blockers. No unconditional green aggregator or independent test weakening.
5. **Update the Sprint 1 integration handoff and issue #92** to link the architecture delta and E2E matrix, listing decisions deferred until after Sprint 1. Preserve the original owner-accepted Resource Management visual baseline and its evidence.

## Approved reference ideas — no copying

- OpenTelemetry: modular signal pipeline and compatibility, not a replacement of the approved collector/durability contract.
- SigNoz: cross-signal diagnostic context, not a mandatory ClickHouse migration.
- Uptime Kuma: simple operator journeys/status freshness, not reduced tenant security.
- Prometheus: metric/labels/query/rule discipline and cardinality budgets, not fabricated ETL completion from scrapes.
- Grafana: panel hierarchy/time selectors/history/drilldowns/annotations, not cloned UI or mandatory Grafana service.

## Explicitly out of scope for this small patch

No new SQLAlchemy models, Alembic migrations, API behavior changes, collector binary/version change, new database/TSDB, incident UI reintroduction, copy of code/assets, operational dashboard redesign, typography implementation, final brand choice, or root Apache-2.0 licensing switch. Any proposed change requiring those gets its own architecture RFC and **individual owner approval after Sprint 1**. If existing acceptance tests can be safely tightened without affecting those contracts, document the exact baseline and isolated new test.

## Completion and non-goals

Provide exact commit SHA, files, test commands, pass/skip/fail, validated matrix rows and unresolved paths. No assertion that all end-to-end workflows are certified. Keep existing workflow checks and branch protection (ruleset 26082467), owner visual acceptance already recorded, independent engineering approval required, security/NOTICE/CVE gates blocking, and CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO. Do not merge, deploy or begin Sprint 2.

comments.body:
Owner reference-list extension (2026-11-09): add **Sumo Logic, Datadog, and New Relic** alongside OpenTelemetry, SigNoz, Uptime Kuma, Prometheus, and Grafana (eight total) under parent [#92](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/issues/92).

This is **benchmarking and E2E verification traceability only**, not a scope expansion for this already-approved small Sprint 1 patch. Where relevant, cite:
- **Sumo Logic:** structured log exploration, field extraction, monitored-source-to-event search, investigation pivots; OpsControl should preserve provenance/tenant scope and avoid pretending log correlation is proof of ETL outcome.
- **Datadog:** Windows/Linux host/process explorer, tags/facets, time-series context, grouped threshold alerts and notification routing; OpsControl should emphasize selected processes, freshness, quiet/unknown state and alert deduplication.
- **New Relic:** entity relationships/dependency navigation, global time ranges, issue grouping and workflow context; OpsControl should map resource→process/service→ETL identity/evidence with explicit relationship provenance and authorization.

**Current code changes remain restricted** to architecture documentation, bounded E2E verification matrix and its integrity guard per original #95. No copied third-party code, assets, UI, rule syntax or agents; no new commercial dependencies, new SIEM/APM feature or storage engine, migrations or collector changes. Finalize detailed implementation priorities with individual approvals after Sprint 1. Do not interrupt the existing Codex work on draft PR #89 or remove CI/security/review gates.

title: OC-S1-ARCH-001 — Small Sprint 1 architecture alignment and E2E workflow evidence matrix
